title: Deploy windows
text: Production deploys run Monday to Thursday, 09:00 to 16:00 Eastern. Friday deploys need approval from the on-call lead.

title: Rollback policy
text: Any engineer may roll back a release without approval. Rollbacks must be announced in #deploys within 10 minutes.

title: On-call rotation
text: On-call shifts last one week and hand over every Tuesday at 10:00 Eastern. Each shift has a primary and a secondary.

title: Pager response
text: The primary must acknowledge a page within 5 minutes. After 15 minutes without acknowledgement the page escalates to the secondary.

title: Severity levels
text: SEV1 means customers cannot use the product. SEV2 means a major feature is degraded. SEV3 is a minor issue with a workaround.

title: Postmortems
text: Every SEV1 and SEV2 needs a blameless postmortem, published within 5 business days of the incident.

title: Feature flags
text: New features ship behind a feature flag. Flags that have been fully rolled out for 30 days must be removed from the code.

title: Flag naming
text: Feature flags are named team_feature_purpose in snake case, for example search_rerank_enabled.

title: CI time budget
text: The pull request pipeline must finish in under 15 minutes. Slow test suites are split and run in parallel.

title: Flaky tests
text: A test that fails and then passes on retry is quarantined within one day and fixed or deleted within two weeks.

title: Build log retention
text: CI build logs are kept for 90 days. Release build logs are kept for one year.

title: Code review
text: Every pull request needs one approving review. Changes to Helm charts or CI workflows also need a review from the platform team.

title: Environments
text: There are three shared environments: dev, staging and prod. Preview environments are created per pull request and deleted after 48 hours.

title: Secrets handling
text: Secrets live in the cloud secret manager and are mounted at runtime. Secrets must never be committed to git or printed in logs.

title: API key rotation
text: Third-party API keys are rotated every 90 days, or immediately if a key may have been exposed.

title: Benchmark gate
text: Every release runs the latency benchmark. A p95 latency regression of more than 15 percent against the baseline blocks the release.

title: LLM evaluations
text: Model or prompt changes must pass the offline eval suite. Retrieval hit rate must stay at or above 0.85.

title: Test data
text: Tests use synthetic data only. Customer data must never be copied into dev, staging or CI.

title: Air-gapped installs
text: Air-gapped customers receive container images and Helm charts as an offline bundle. These installs make no external network calls.

title: Support hours
text: Enterprise support covers 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for SEV1. SEV2 and SEV3 are handled during business hours.
